# HA fixtures

24 sanitized publisher pages captured 2026-10-23. Only main-content anchors, headings, title, version paragraphs and deduplicated Resources navigation remain; script bodies are discarded, literal popup hrefs retained. `manifest.json` records the page URL and SHA-256 of each sanitized extract. `expected.json` contains the approved Option B inventory and four existing names. Both are test evidence, not runtime URL allowlists.
